title: Smoke bomb

infobox.Crafting Materials: Smoke puff x1, Asksvin bladder x1

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Smoke bomb is a thrown weapon introduced in the Ashlands biome.
When thrown, it will leave an area of smoke that sets the Smoked status effect to any creature not immune to it, such as the player that threw it
Smoke bombs extinguish fire in a 3-meter radius around the impact.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text:
• Crafted with the Workbench.
• Smoke puffs can be found in the Ashlands biome.
• Asksvin bladders are dropped from Asksvin.
